# JBC Painting & Decorating

> Licensed, insured house painters based in Kariong NSW 2250, servicing the Central Coast of New South Wales, Australia. 20+ years' experience. Uses Dulux and Haymes paints exclusively. Phone 0402 360 514 · info@jbcpainting.com.au · ABN 91 883 662 973 · Hours Mon–Fri 7am–5pm, Sat 8am–2pm.

## Services
- [Interior painting](https://jbcpainting.com.au/services/interior-painting): walls, ceilings, trims, doors, low-VOC options
- [Exterior painting](https://jbcpainting.com.au/services/exterior-painting): weatherboard, render, brick, fibro; coastal-grade systems
- [Roof painting](https://jbcpainting.com.au/services/roof-painting): concrete tile and metal/Colorbond roof restoration
- [Commercial painting](https://jbcpainting.com.au/services/commercial-painting): offices, retail, hospitality, after-hours work
- [Strata painting](https://jbcpainting.com.au/services/strata-painting): unit blocks, villas, common areas
- [New home painting](https://jbcpainting.com.au/services/new-home-painting): new builds, extensions, renovations
- [Feature walls & decorative finishes](https://jbcpainting.com.au/services/feature-walls-decorative-finishes)

## Pricing (2026, Central Coast)
- [Painting cost guide](https://jbcpainting.com.au/painting-cost-central-coast): interior walls $18–$35/m²; full 3-bed interior $6,000–$10,500; single-storey exterior $4,500–$14,000; roof restoration $3,500–$8,000
